headword: {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}

definitions.gloss: autumn rain front; fall stationary front
definitions.explanation: A weather front that brings prolonged rainy weather to Japan in September and October, similar to the rainy season front ({梅雨前線|ばいうぜんせん}) but occurring in autumn.

examples.japanese: {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The autumn rain front is causing continued rainfall.

examples.japanese: {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停滞|ていたい}して→停滞する：26992_teitaisuru⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧だ。
examples.english: The autumn rain front is stalled, and rain is forecast all weekend.

examples.japanese: {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: When a typhoon combines with the autumn rain front, the risk of disasters from heavy rain increases.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{秋雨|あきさめ}→秋雨：16749_akisame⟧ (autumn rain) + ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧ (weather front). This meteorological phenomenon is the autumn counterpart to the {梅雨前線|ばいうぜんせん} (rainy season front) that occurs in June-July. The ⟦{秋雨|あきさめ}→秋雨：16749_akisame⟧ period typically lasts from mid-September through October.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: effects of the autumn rain front
- {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停滞|ていたい}する→停滞する：26992_teitaisuru⟧: the autumn rain front stagnates
- {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the autumn rain front becomes active
- {秋雨前線|あきさめぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{南下|なんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the autumn rain front moves south

SEASONAL CONTEXT:
Japan experiences two extended rainy periods: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ in early summer and ⟦{秋雨|あきさめ}→秋雨：16749_akisame⟧ in early autumn. The autumn rains tend to be less predictable and can be intensified by late-season typhoons.

RELATED WORDS:
- {梅雨前線|ばいうぜんせん}: rainy season front (summer counterpart)
- ⟦{秋雨|あきさめ}→秋雨：16749_akisame⟧: autumn rain
- ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧: weather front
- {停滞前線|ていたいぜんせん}: stationary front
